summary: Master machine learning for credit scoring, algorithmic trading, and financial risk management. Build explainable AI models and ensure regulatory compliance.
lede: Artificial Intelligence in Finance, Investments and Credit applies machine learning, natural language processing and predictive analytics to financial workflows. This course shows you how to use alternative data, build predictive credit scoring models, analyse market sentiment, support portfolio decisions and identify fraudulent anomalies. You will practise configuring financial AI tools, interpreting their outputs and testing algorithmic trading strategies. The training also covers model fairness, explainability, governance and audit documentation, helping you balance predictive performance with transparency, compliance and practical financial operations.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive program is tailored for financial professionals who are responsible for integrating advanced analytics and machine learning into institutional workflows.
modules: Machine Learning for Credit Risk Modeling
Natural Language Processing in Investment Strategy
Algorithmic Bias and Fair Lending Compliance
Model Risk Management and AI Governance
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of financial markets, credit risk, or investment management. Familiarity with basic statistical concepts and data analysis is required. While prior programming experience (such as Python or R) is highly beneficial for the hands-on exercises, non-coding professionals will be provided with pre-configured templates and low-code tools to complete the practical deliverables.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
